units.source_text: 从蜜橘园一带向上推到最顶点，轨道立马变成了下坡路。

en.t: After they pushed it upward from around the mandarin orange grove to the highest point, the track immediately became a downhill slope.

units.source_text: 身穿条纹衬衣的工人对良平喊了声：“喂，一起上车吧。”

en.t: The worker in the striped shirt called out to Ryohei, "Hey, get on with us."

units.source_text: 良平马上抬脚跳上矿车。

en.t: Ryohei immediately lifted his foot and jumped onto the mine cart.

units.source_text: 三个人刚登上矿车，与此同时，

en.t: Just as the three of them had climbed into the mine cart,

units.source_text: 矿车已扇动着蜜橘园里的香气，飞快地从轨道上滑了下去。

en.t: the mine cart was already fanning the fragrance of the mandarin orange grove as it swiftly slid down along the track.

units.source_text: “乘矿车比推矿车要快乐更多呢。”

en.t: "Riding in a mine cart is much more fun than pushing one."

units.source_text: ——良平让自己的外衣鼓着风，想着这理所当然的道理。

en.t: Ryohei let the wind billow out his jacket and thought about that obvious truth.

units.source_text: “推着矿车走的路越多，回来时乘矿车的时间也越多。”

en.t: "The farther we push the mine cart, the longer we will get to ride it on the way back."
